name: 98226 · Bellingham, WA
findings: ZIP 98226 (Bellingham) has 195 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98226 (Bellingham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98226 (Bellingham) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
